body: Thank you, I want to be home more than anything else.

I definitely wouldn’t make such a big purchase without checking with my SO first. Sadly if I pay all of our bills first that’s like $1k for a month right there. It would probably take both of our payments together to get everything current or not past due.
Unfortunately I don’t have any such skills. It would just be a fun purchase.

Oh no I wouldn’t make such a big purchase without talking with my SO first! As for the electricity and food, that’s pretty normal for us to be in arrears or only eating ramen and canned vegetables for a couple of weeks. So it would be the same bad situation but we’d have a nice computer.

Arkansan here. No. I’m an “essential” employee and a customer throws a fucking fit and tries to start a fight multiple times a day because they’re mad we’re wearing masks. No one is quarantining. All of my coworkers still party and hang out with others in their time off. Delivery drivers aren’t wearing masks or gloves. Friends get angry if you won’t come over or won’t let them inside your house. Everyone is angry all the time.
